related.title: ResNet：殘差路徑與梯度檢核
related.titleEn: ResNet: residual paths and gradient checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付分支介面表、MAC拆解及瓶頸品質取捨。；兩份MAC表吻合，分支空間尺寸一致；若瓶頸品質下降超教學2百分點則拒絕。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver branch contracts, MAC decomposition and bottleneck quality tradeoffs.; MAC sheets agree and branch spatial sizes match; reject if the teaching quality loss exceeds2 percentage points.
related.difference: 畫主路徑與恆等旁路在加法節點會合；明列兩路輸出shape需相同。；中心差分與解析值誤差小於教學1e−6，並列出線性假設與投影例外。
related.differenceEn: Draw the main and identity paths meeting at addition; require identical output shapes.; Finite differences agree within teaching tolerance1e−6, with linear assumptions and projection exceptions stated.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 1×1降維再3×3的每位置MAC=CinB+9BCout；分支串接沿通道軸。；教學Cin=64、瓶頸B=16、Cout=32，省略偏置與激活。；MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632；B=8時2816。直接3×3為18432。
簡化標量塊y=x+ax，局部導數為1+a；串接L塊為(1+a)^L，僅限線性無激活示例。；教學a=0.1、L=3，與a=−0.1比較；不是實際ResNet訓練結果。；g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331；a=−0.1時g=0.729。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A1×1 reduction followed by3×3 costs CinB+9BCout MACs per position; branches concatenate along channels.; Teaching Cin=64, bottleneck B=16 and Cout=32; omit biases and activations.; MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632; B=8 gives2816. Direct3×3 costs18432.

For scalar y=x+ax, the local derivative is1+a; L blocks give(1+a)^L, limited to this linear example without activations.; Teaching a=0.1,L=3, compared with a=−0.1; these are not measured ResNet training results.; g=(1+0.1)^3=1.331; at a=−0.1,g=0.729.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FPN：金字塔融合與空間預算
related.titleEn: FPN: pyramid fusion and spatial budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付分支介面表、MAC拆解及瓶頸品質取捨。；兩份MAC表吻合，分支空間尺寸一致；若瓶頸品質下降超教學2百分點則拒絕。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver branch contracts, MAC decomposition and bottleneck quality tradeoffs.; MAC sheets agree and branch spatial sizes match; reject if the teaching quality loss exceeds2 percentage points.
related.difference: 標四層相對步幅及上採樣箭頭；側向1×1先把各層通道映至同一寬度。；總位置5440及21824正確，所有側向相加座標契約一致。
related.differenceEn: Label relative strides and upsampling arrows; lateral1×1 projections first align channel widths.; Counts5440 and21824 match and lateral additions share consistent coordinate contracts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 1×1降維再3×3的每位置MAC=CinB+9BCout；分支串接沿通道軸。；教學Cin=64、瓶頸B=16、Cout=32，省略偏置與激活。；MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632；B=8時2816。直接3×3為18432。
金字塔每層長寬減半，總位置數是各層面積和；側向相加需對齊通道與座標。；教學四層64、32、16、8方形網格；擴充一層128。；N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440；加128層為21824。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A1×1 reduction followed by3×3 costs CinB+9BCout MACs per position; branches concatenate along channels.; Teaching Cin=64, bottleneck B=16 and Cout=32; omit biases and activations.; MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632; B=8 gives2816. Direct3×3 costs18432.

Each pyramid level halves both dimensions; total positions sum areas, and lateral addition requires aligned channels and coordinates.; Teaching square grids64,32,16,8; add a128 level.; N=64²+32²+16²+8²=5440; adding128 gives21824.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
